text:
zoe_cs: Quick debrief from FernLabs onboarding call. Their midday surge (11:30-12:30 local) is showing p95 ~3.1s on chat completions (avg response ~450 tokens). Running on rwd-ceres-3b-8k fp16 today. They9re enthusiastic about cost savings but UX is brittle during spikes. Renewal flagged as soon as we can show a perf plan.

matt_se: Two-prong idea: 1) response-length-aware routing (short responses -> compact quantized 3B), 2) int4 (nf4) pilot of rwd-ceres-3b to reduce compute. Also tighten batching to 8-10ms for latency-critical routes.

anya_ml: Int4 looks promising but watch calibration and sampling entropy. Recommend a 150-critical-prompt fidelity set (customer-provided + anonymized edge cases). We'll run automated metrics (semantic similarity, top-k overlap) + 30 manual checks. Expect int4 nf4 -> ~35-45% cost drop, p95 down from 3.1s -> ~1.0-1.5s for compact paths.

tom_pm: Customer wants a 1-slide blurb for renewal team: expected p95, cost delta, risk list, and rollback path. Can you give numbers by EOD?

matt_se: Draft routing snippet (Console API) for an initial 6% canary + length-based route: 

```
# route: fern-length-aware-canary
routes:
  - name: fern-length-aware-canary
    canary_pct: 6
    rules:
      - if: response_tokens_estimate <= 300
        models:
          - id: rwd-ceres-3b-8k-nf4
            weight: 0.06
          - id: rwd-ceres-3b-8k
            weight: 0.94
      - else:
        models:
          - id: rwd-ceres-3b-8k
            weight: 1.0
    batching_ms: 9
    prefix_kv_cache: true
```

matt_se: We'll also tag traffic with route=fern-canary and exclude flows flagged in their config (billing/legal).

anya_ml: Rollout/rollback triggers: auto-rollback if: 1) semantic-fidelity delta < -0.015 on the 150-set for 15 continuous mins OR 2) p95 increases >10% vs baseline for 20 mins OR 3) error-rate (timeouts/5xx) increases by 25% absolute. Also quarantine any samples with PII hits from the canary.

zoe_cs: I'll ask Fern to share the 150 prompts (anonymized) by EOD. Action owners: matt -> implement canary + runbook; anya -> run int4 eval + manual checks; tom -> slide blurb and contact list. I'll schedule a 20m checkpoint 2h after canary start.

ops-bot: Preview deployment: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/preview/fern-canary-6012345678 

matt_se: Example curl to create route (internal runbook will have full flags): 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @fern-length-aware-canary.json
```

anya_ml: I9ll publish the eval diff in the shared doc with examples flagged for manual review. If semantic regressions <= 0.5% we proceed to expand 6% -> 25% after 36h of green signals. If 0.5% < regressions < 2% we do a 100-sample manual audit.

zoe_cs: Also propose a short safety measure: sample 1% of canary responses for human-in-the-loop checks during the first 6 hours for any hallucination/safety drift. Fern agreed to that.

ops-bot: Canary started at 6012345699. Live logs: https://console.redwood.ai/logs/canary/6012345699

tom_pm: I9ll draft the renewal slide with those numbers and the rollback playbook by 5pm PT.

zoe_cs: Thanks team. If all looks good after the 2h checkpoint we9ll propose phased rollout and include the one-click rollback in the renewal notes. :rocket:
